A.description: the input tensor of size :math:`(*, m, n)`

q.description: a slightly overestimated rank of A.

niter.description: the number of subspace iterations to conduct; niter must be a nonnegative integer, and defaults to 2

M.description: the input tensor's mean of size :math:`(*, m, n)`, which will be broadcasted to the size of A in this function.

output.description: Return the singular value decomposition ``(U, S, V)`` of a matrix,
